Overview

Rent Collector (ভাড়া আদায়) helps Bangladeshi landlords manage rooms, tenants, meters and electricity bills — and see exactly who hasn’t paid, for which month.

What I owned

  • →Run the product end to end as founder: requirement and feature analysis through to finalised tickets
  • →Build and ship both the Android app and the web app
  • →Handle customer support myself, and feed what landlords ask for back into the roadmap

Key decision

Bangla‑first UI and mobile‑number sign‑in, because that’s how landlords in Bangladesh actually work.
